[d0307] config | broker.enabled | version 4.x
# `broker.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `false` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | broker |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `broker.enabled` only if you observe problems with the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[broker]
enabled = false
```

---

[d0260] config | broker.compression (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `broker.compression` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Compression codec that the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `lz4` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | broker |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `broker.compression` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[broker]
compression = "lz4"
```
